quests.title: Simple Chores

dialogue.t: What? I'm running transport safety today? Oh, crumbs. The director's gonna have my head for this! S—Seeya, I'm out!
Oh... Is this late already? I didn't even know... Ugh... Should've drunk maybe two cups less last night...
Sorry? Transport safety? Me? He didn't tell me about that... Ugh, whatever. I'll get a move on....

quests.description: The engineering supervisor, Sobolev, seems to need help…
